company.shortDescription: Smartzi is an AI-powered smart property, hospitality, and IoT automation solutions platform.
company.description: Smartzi is an AI-driven IoT and proptech platform transforming properties and hotels into sustainable, personalized smart living spaces. The company integrates multi-brand smart devices, analytics, and automation to improve guest experiences, energy efficiency, and operational management. Smartzi serves hospitality and real estate sectors across the Middle East and North America.
